provenance.method: AN-19-083 App. A: sigma_NLO(m_lN)/sigma_Born(m_lN) from MG5_aMC fixed-order runs, EffLRSM_NLO, 5FS, lhaid 325300, points summed with their own cross sections
provenance.lo_norm_note: k(m_lN) = c x NLO(m_lN) / LO(m_lN, official run_card, MG 2.9.18); c = mean of LO(2.9.18) / LO(sample, GenXSecAnalyzer) over the points shared with the official grid, so that sigma(sample) x <k> = sigma_NLO; c is the Breit-Wigner truncation of the samples' decay chain (bwcutoff = 15 keeps 97.9 % of the resonance), not a MadGraph-version effect (2.6.5 and 2.9.18 agree to 0.1 %): docs/signal_kfactor.md
provenance.note: direct_k: the point's c x sigma_NLO / sigma_LO(official card) (config normalisation, genxsec_campaign.py --signal-norm direct); point_curves: its own NLO/LO m_lN ratio (the analyzer's k(m_lN)); averages: <k> of each sample and channel over its generated events (average_k.py); kfactor: the shared curve of all points (fallback). docs/signal_kfactor.md
